NATO strap in the render (18 official)
notes: Built from Hamilton's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is small; it is kept as a second front reference).

Modelled: brushed cushion case with a polished edge and a polished lip round the crystal, lance hour and needle minute hands with beige lume, polished seconds needle, fluted crown, grey NATO strap running under the case with the house curl.
From the photo map: black grained dial, printed white numerals, beige triangle, bars and dots, white chapter ring, Hamilton logo, Mechanical, Swiss Made; the strap weave.
The hour hand covers the 0 of 10 in the render; its covered half is mirrored from the visible half. Heights are estimated (no side photo).
